items.title: Automate optics, copilot execution, spar on impact
items.summary: Enterprise: Borrowing Shreyas Doshi's three levels of product work, Christine Xu maps each to a mode: Claude as autopilot for optics work (status updates, visibility), Claude as copilot for execution (weekly context dumps, planning, customer themes), and Claude as sparring partner for the hardest-to-start impact work. Automate optics ruthlessly; ask for judgment, not just summaries.
